Campanulaceae.key_door: individual sympetalous flower + inferior ovary; Triodanis = free stamens + lower-poricidal capsule, Lobelia = bilabiate corolla + fused anther tube + plunger pollen presentation

anchor_families.Asteraceae: both Asterales and commonly inferior-ovaried; Campanulaceae has individual many-seeded flowers/capsules while Asteraceae has capitula and 1-seeded cypselae

taxonomy_notes: Triodanis biflora is currently treated by Kew as a synonym of accepted Triodanis perfoliata subsp. biflora.
Triodanis perfoliata, T. texana, T. coloradoensis, T. leptocarpa, and Lobelia cardinalis remain accepted current species concepts.
Six source rows therefore represent five species-level concepts plus one accepted subspecies nested in T. perfoliata.
guardrails: Family/genus recognition only; no species promotion.
Do not teach Campanulaceae as a blue/bell-shaped-flower family.
Do not double-count Triodanis biflora as a separate current species from Triodanis perfoliata.
Use stamen architecture and capsule dehiscence as the primary Triodanis-vs-Lobelia teaching split.
